title: Categorical Torelli theorems for higher Picard rank Fano double covers
summary: We prove categorical Torelli theorems for four families of Fano double covers with Picard rank greater than 1. Among these is the family of Verra fourfolds. The other three families manifest as double covers of Fano threefolds, branched in anticanonical K3 surfaces.
